entries.uzbek: sopqon; manjaniq; nayza; nayzador; xushbo‘y moy; o‘tkir hidli mushk

meanings.uzbekMeaning: tosh yoki boshqa snaryadni otishda ishlatiladigan sopqon
meanings.uzbekExample: U toshni sopqon bilan otdi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: katta tosh va snaryadlarni uloqtiradigan qadimiy qamal quroli — manjaniq
meanings.uzbekExample: Qamalda manjaniqdan foydalanildi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: sanchib urishga mo‘ljallangan uzun sopli qurol — nayza
meanings.uzbekExample: Jangchi nayzasini ko‘tardi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: nayza bilan ko‘p yoki mohirona sanchib uradigan jangchi
meanings.uzbekExample: U nayza bilan mohirona jang qiladigan nayzador edi.

meanings.arabicGloss: دُهْنٌ يُتَّخَذُ مِنَ الزَّيْتِ بِأَفَاوِيهِ الطِّيبِ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: zaytun moyiga turli xushbo‘y ziravorlar qo‘shib tayyorlanadigan moy
meanings.uzbekExample: Xushbo‘y moy zaytun moyi va hidli ziravorlardan tayyorlandi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: hidi kuchli taraladigan, o‘tkir va xushbo‘y mushk
meanings.uzbekExample: Mushkning xushbo‘y hidi uzoqqa taraldi.

issues: مِقْلاَعٌ miltiq emas, sopqon
To‘rtinchi ma’no «nayza bilan urish» harakati emas, nayza bilan sanchuvchi jangchi

entries.uzbek: o‘ta mehribon; al-Hannon diniy sifati; mehrga to‘la ayol

meanings.uzbekMeaning: tabiatan juda yumshoq ko‘ngilli, mehribon, rahmdil va shafqatli
meanings.uzbekExample: U tabiatan mehribon va rahmdil edi.

meanings.arabicGloss: مِنْ أَسْمَاءِ اللَّهِ الحُسْنَى بِمَعْنَى الرَّحِيمِ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: al-Hannon — manbada Allohning go‘zal ismi va «rahmli» ma’nosida keltirilgan; uning ism sifatida sahih dalil bilan sobitligi haqida olimlar o‘rtasida ixtilof bor
meanings.uzbekExample: Manba al-Hannonni «rahmli» ma’nosidagi ilohiy ism deb beradi, ammo bu tasnif diniy adjudikatsiyani talab qiladi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: farzandi yoki yaqiniga juda kuchli mehr va shafqat ko‘rsatadigan ayol

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعَّال لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|-وَرَقٌ نَشَّاشٌ : وَرَقٌ يَمْتَصُّ الحِبْرَ وَيُجَفِّفُ الكِتَابَةَ، نَشَّافٌ.
entries.uzbek: siyohni shimib, yozuvni quritadigan qog‘oz

meanings.arabicGloss: وَرَقٌ يَمْتَصُّ الحِبْرَ وَيُجَفِّفُ الكِتَابَةَ، نَشَّافٌ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: ho‘l siyohni shimib olib, qo‘lyozma yoki yozuvni quritishda ishlatiladigan maxsus qog‘oz
meanings.uzbekExample: U ho‘l siyohni maxsus shimuvchi qog‘oz bilan quritdi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعَّال لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|-وَلَدٌ خَرَّاصٌ : كَذَّابٌ.الذاريات آية 10 قُتِلَ الخَرَّاصُونَ (قرآن) .
entries.uzbek: yolg‘on taxmin va uydirmani ko‘p gapiradigan

meanings.uzbekMeaning: dalilsiz taxmin, uydirma va yolg‘on gaplarni ko‘p aytadigan kishi

issues: Yolg‘onchilik va dalilsiz taxmin manbadagi bitta uydirmachilik doirasida saqlandi
Zoriyot surasi 51:10 misoli tarjima qilindi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعَّال لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|-وَلَدٌ نَزَّالٌ : كَثِيرُ النُّزُولِ، أَوْ كَثِيرُ الْمُنَازَلَةِ.
entries.uzbek: ko‘p tushadigan yoki ko‘p yakkama-yakka olishadigan

meanings.uzbekMeaning: biror joydan ko‘p tushadigan yoki raqib bilan yuzma-yuz va yakkama-yakka olishuvga ko‘p kirishadigan kishi
meanings.uzbekExample: U tez-tez pastga tushar, jangda esa raqib bilan yuzma-yuz olishardi.

issues: كَثِيرُ النُّزُولِ va كَثِيرُ الْمُنَازَلَةِ manbada «yoki» bilan bog‘langan bitta yozuv; sun’iy ikki ma’no yasalmadi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعَّال لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).| الَّذِي يَنْخُلُ الدَّقِيقَ.
entries.uzbek: unni elaydigan elakchi

meanings.uzbekMeaning: unni elakdan o‘tkazib elaydigan kishi — elakchi
meanings.uzbekExample: Elakchi unni mayda elakdan o‘tkazdi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعَّال لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).| صَانِعُ الصَّابُونِ وَبَائِعُهُ- لَمْ يَكُنِ الصَّبّانُ لِيَغِيبَ عَنِ القَرْيَةِ لأَنَّ صَابُونَهُ مَرْغوبٌ فِيهِ.
entries.uzbek: sovun tayyorlovchi va sotuvchi

meanings.arabicGloss: صَانِعُ الصَّابُونِ وَبَائِعُهُ- لَمْ يَكُنِ الصَّبّانُ لِيَغِيبَ عَنِ القَرْيَةِ لأَنَّ صَابُونَهُ مَرْغوبٌ فِيهِ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: sovun ishlab chiqaradigan va uni sotadigan hunarmand yoki savdogar
meanings.uzbekExample: Sovunchi qishloqdan ketmas edi, chunki uning sovuniga talab katta edi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعَّال لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).| صَانِعُ، بَائِعُ الْهَرِيسَةِ.
entries.uzbek: harisa taomini tayyorlovchi yoki sotuvchi

meanings.uzbekMeaning: harisa deb ataladigan taomni tayyorlaydigan yoki sotadigan kishi
meanings.uzbekExample: Harisa tayyorlovchi va sotuvchi bozorda ishlar edi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعَّال لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).| الرعد آية 16وَهُوَ الوَاحِدُ القَهَّار ( قرآن) : مِنْ أَسْمَاءِ اللَّهِ الْحُسْنَى، أَيِ الغَالِبُ الَّذِي لاَ يَحُدُّ غَلَبَتَهُ شَيْءٌ- قَهَّارٌ، قَهَّارٌ حُبُّكَ يَا بَلَدِي يَخْطِفُنِي يَسْبِينِي. (عبد الرفيع جواهري).
entries.uzbek: Al-Qahhor — hech kim qarshi turolmaydigan darajada mutlaq g‘olib Zot

meanings.arabicGloss: مِنْ أَسْمَاءِ اللَّهِ الْحُسْنَى، أَيِ الغَالِبُ الَّذِي لاَ يَحُدُّ غَلَبَتَهُ شَيْءٌ- قَهَّارٌ، قَهَّارٌ حُبُّكَ يَا بَلَدِي يَخْطِفُنِي يَسْبِينِي. (عبد الرفيع جواهري).
meanings.uzbekMeaning: Al-Qahhor — Allohning go‘zal ismlaridan biri; g‘olibligini hech narsa cheklay olmaydigan, barcha narsani O‘z hukmiga bo‘ysundiruvchi Zot; majozan bir tuyg‘uning kishini butunlay egallashi haqida ham ishlatiladi
meanings.uzbekExample: U Yagona va Qahhordir. (Qur’on, Ra’d surasi, 13:16) «Yurtim, sevging meni egallab, asir etadi» mazmunida majozan ham qo‘llangan.

issues: Al-Qahhor ma’nosi «barcha narsaga qodir»dan farq qiladi; hech kim qarshi turolmaydigan mutlaq g‘olib va bo‘ysundiruvchi ma’nosi tiklandi
Ra’d surasi 13:16 misoli saqlandi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعَّال لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).| صَانِعُ النُّحَاسِ الأَصْفَرِ.
entries.uzbek: jezdan buyum yasaydigan usta

meanings.uzbekMeaning: sariq mis — jezdan buyumlar yasaydigan usta
meanings.uzbekExample: Usta jezdan turli buyumlar yasadi.

issues: النُّحَاسُ الأَصْفَرُ umumiy mis emas, jez; kasb shunga toraytirildi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعَّال لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|1- تِلْمِيذٌ غَيَّابٌ : كَثِيرُ الغِيَابِ.|2- غَيَّابُ الشَّجَرِ : عُرُوقُهُ.
entries.uzbek: darsga ko‘p kelmaydigan; daraxt ildizlari

meanings.uzbekMeaning: o‘quvchi haqida: darsga ko‘p kelmaydigan, tez-tez sababsiz yo‘q bo‘ladigan
meanings.uzbekExample: O‘quvchi darslarda tez-tez yo‘q bo‘lardi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: daraxtning yer ostidagi ildizlari
meanings.uzbekExample: Daraxt ildizlari yerga chuqur kirib borgan edi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعَّال لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|1- ذُبَابٌ طَنَّانٌ : شَدِيدُ الطَّنِينِ.|2- أَلْقَى خِطَاباً طَنَّاناً : مُدَوِّيّاً، لَهُ صَدىً وَاسِعٌ.|3- قَصِيدَةٌ طَنَّانَةٌ : ذَاتُ شُهْرَةٍ، ذَائِعَةُ الصِّيتِ.
entries.uzbek: qattiq g‘uvillaydigan; aks-sadosi keng nutq; dong‘i ketgan she’r

meanings.uzbekMeaning: pashsha yoki hasharot haqida: qattiq va baland g‘uvillaydigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Pashsha qattiq g‘uvillardi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: nutq haqida: jarangdor, aks-sadosi va ta’sir doirasi keng
meanings.uzbekExample: U jarangdor va keng aks-sado bergan nutq so‘zladi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: she’r yoki asar haqida: mashhur, dong‘i keng tarqalgan
meanings.uzbekExample: Bu dong‘i ketgan mashhur she’r edi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعَّال لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|1- رَجُلٌ خَطَّافٌ : كَثِيرُ الْخَطْفِ- لِصٌّ خَطَّافٌ.|2- هُوَ خَطَّافٌ : شَيْطَانٌ.
entries.uzbek: narsani tez tortib oladigan o‘g‘ri; shayton

meanings.uzbekMeaning: narsani egasidan tez va kutilmaganda yulqib yoki tortib olib qochadigan o‘g‘ri
meanings.uzbekExample: O‘g‘ri narsani yulqib olib qochdi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: shayton
meanings.uzbekExample: Manbada bu so‘z shayton ma’nosida ham keltirilgan.

issues: Birinchi ma’no umumiy o‘g‘irlik emas, narsani tez yulqib yoki tortib olish
Ikkinchi ta’rif faqat shaytonni aytadi; qo‘shimcha «yovuz ruh» umumlashtirmasi olib tashlandi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعَّال لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|1- رَجُلٌ صَقَّارٌ : نَمَّامٌ.|2.: مُدَرِّبُ الصَّقْرِ.|3.: مَنْ يَصِيدُ بِالصَّقْرِ.
entries.uzbek: chaqimchi; lochin murabbiyi; lochin bilan ovchi

meanings.uzbekMeaning: odamlar orasida gap tashib, chaqimchilik qiladigan kishi
meanings.uzbekExample: U odamlar orasida gap tashuvchi chaqimchi edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: lochin yoki boshqa ovchi qushni ovga o‘rgatadigan murabbiy
meanings.uzbekExample: Lochin murabbiyi qushni ovga o‘rgatdi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: lochin bilan ov qiladigan ovchi — lochinboz
meanings.uzbekExample: Lochinboz qushi bilan ovga chiqdi.

issues: نَمَّامٌ oddiy g‘iybatchi emas, chaqimchi va gap tashuvchi

entries.uzbek: ko‘p suzib oluvchi; odimi keng ot; sersuv daryo; mo‘l yomg‘ir

meanings.uzbekMeaning: suv yoki suyuqlikni idish bilan qayta-qayta va ko‘p suzib oladigan kishi
meanings.uzbekExample: U suvni idish bilan ko‘p suzib oldi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: ot haqida: qadami va odimi keng
meanings.uzbekExample: Ot keng odimlab yurardi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: daryo haqida: suvi ko‘p, sersuv
meanings.uzbekExample: Bu juda sersuv daryo edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: yomg‘ir haqida: mo‘l va shiddatli
meanings.uzbekExample: Mo‘l yomg‘ir yog‘di.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعَّال لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|1- رَجُلٌ لَوَّامٌ : كَثِيرُ اللَّوْمِ.|2- النَّفْسُ اللَّوَّامَةُ : أَيِ النَّفْسُ الَّتِي اكْتَسَبَتْ مَنَاعَةً وَفَضِيلَةً فَتَلُومُ صَاحِبَهَا إِذَا ارْتَكَبَ مَا يُلاَمُ عَلَيْهِ. | القيامة آية 1 ، 2لا أَقْسِمُ بِيَوْمِ القِيامَةِ وَلا أَقْسِمُ بِالنَّفْسِ اللَّوَّامَةِ (قرآن).
entries.uzbek: ko‘p malomat qiluvchi; o‘zini malomat qiluvchi nafs

meanings.uzbekMeaning: boshqalarni tez-tez koyib, ayblab va malomat qiladigan kishi
meanings.uzbekExample: U boshqalarni ko‘p koyib, malomat qilardi.

meanings.arabicGloss: أَيِ النَّفْسُ الَّتِي اكْتَسَبَتْ مَنَاعَةً وَفَضِيلَةً فَتَلُومُ صَاحِبَهَا إِذَا ارْتَكَبَ مَا يُلاَمُ عَلَيْهِ. | القيامة آية 1 ، 2لا أَقْسِمُ بِيَوْمِ القِيامَةِ وَلا أَقْسِمُ بِالنَّفْسِ اللَّوَّامَةِ (قرآن).
meanings.uzbekMeaning: an-nafs al-lawwoma — egasi yomon ish qilganida uni malomat qiladigan, vijdoni uyg‘oq nafs
meanings.uzbekExample: Qiyomat kuniga qasam. O‘zini malomat qiluvchi nafsga ham qasam. (Qur’on, Qiyomat surasi, 75:1–2)

issues: An-nafs al-lawwoma o‘zini shunchaki «tanqid qiladigan» emas, yomon ish uchun egasini malomat qiladigan nafs
Qiyomat surasi 75:1–2 misoli saqlandi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعَّال لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|1- رَجُلٌ مَجَّانٌ :كَثِيرُ الْمُجُونِ وَالعَبَثِ.|2- مَجَّاناً : بِلاَ مُقَابِلٍ، بِلاَ ثَمَنٍ.
entries.uzbek: behayo ermakka berilgan; bepul

meanings.uzbekMeaning: behayo yoki odobsiz hazil, yengiltaklik va befoyda ermakni ko‘p qiladigan kishi
meanings.uzbekExample: U odobsiz hazil va befoyda ermakka berilgan edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: haq, narx yoki boshqa to‘lov talab qilinmaydigan tarzda — bepul
meanings.uzbekExample: Bu xizmat bepul ko‘rsatildi.

issues: الْمُجُونُ umumiy hazilkashlik yoki beparvolik emas, odobsiz hazil va yengiltak ermak ma’nosiga ega

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعَّال لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|1- رَجُلٌ هَدَّاجٌ : يَمْشِي مُرْتَعِشاً مُتَثَاقِلاً فِي ضَعْفٍ.|2- ظَلِيمٌ هَدَّاجٌ : يَمْشِي فِي ارْتِعَاشٍ.
entries.uzbek: qaltirab, og‘ir va zaif qadam tashlaydigan

meanings.uzbekMeaning: kishi haqida: zaiflikdan qaltirab, og‘ir va sust qadam tashlab yuradigan
meanings.uzbekExample: U zaiflikdan qaltirab, og‘ir qadam tashlab yurardi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: erkak tuyaqush haqida: qaltiragandek tebranib yuradigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Erkak tuyaqush tebranib-qaltirab yurardi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعَّال لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|1- سَرَابٌ هَفَّافٌ : بَرَّاقٌ- ضَوْءٌ هَفَّافٌ.|2-  أَجْنِحَةٌ هَفَّافَةٌ : خَفِيفَةٌ للِطَّيَرَانِ.|3-  فُسْتَانٌ هَفَّافٌ : شَفَّافٌ، أَيْ رَقِيقٌ.
entries.uzbek: yarqiragan; uchishga yengil; yupqa va shaffof

meanings.uzbekMeaning: sarob yoki yorug‘lik haqida: yarqiragan, jilvalanib turgan
meanings.uzbekExample: Sarob va yorug‘lik yarqirab jilvalanardi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: qanot haqida: uchishga qulay darajada yengil
meanings.uzbekExample: Qanotlar yengil bo‘lib, uchishga mos edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: mato yoki libos haqida: juda yupqa va osti ko‘rinadigan darajada shaffof
meanings.uzbekExample: Libos yupqa va shaffof matodan tikilgan edi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعَّال لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|1- شَاعِرٌ وَصَّافٌ : عَارِفٌ بِالوَصْفِ.|2- طَبِيبٌ وَصَّافٌ : مُتَمَكِّنٌ مِنْ تَشْخِيصِ الأَمْرَاضِ.
entries.uzbek: tasvirlashga usta shoir; tashxisga mohir shifokor

meanings.uzbekMeaning: shoir yoki yozuvchi haqida: narsa va holatlarni mahorat bilan tasvirlaydigan
meanings.uzbekExample: U tasvirlash san’atini puxta bilgan shoir edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: shifokor haqida: kasallikni to‘g‘ri aniqlash va tashxis qo‘yishda mohir
meanings.uzbekExample: Shifokor kasalliklarni aniqlashda mohir edi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعَّال لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|1- صَوْتٌ هَدَّارٌ : مُجَلْجِلٌ قَوِيٌّ.|2- مَطَرٌ هَدَّارٌ : هَاطِلٌ بِقُوَّةٍ.|3- سَيْلٌ هَدَّارٌ : مُنْدَفِعٌ بِقُوَّةٍ.|4- عَاصِفَةٌ هَدَّارَةٌ : هَوْجَاءُ، عَنِيفَةٌ.|5- خَطِيبٌ هَدَّارٌ : عَنِيفُ اللَّهْجَةِ وَالْكَلاَمِ- يَلْقَانِي بِوَجْهٍ صَلْبٍ وَ لِسانٍ هَدَّارٍ. (التوحيدي).
entries.uzbek: gumburlagan; shiddatli yomg‘ir; jo‘shqin sel; kuchli bo‘ron; keskin notiq

meanings.uzbekMeaning: ovoz haqida: kuchli, gumburlagan va jarangdor
meanings.uzbekExample: Kuchli va gumburlagan ovoz eshitildi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: yomg‘ir haqida: shiddat bilan quyayotgan

meanings.uzbekMeaning: sel yoki oqim haqida: katta kuch va tezlik bilan otilib oqayotgan
meanings.uzbekExample: Sel katta kuch bilan oqib kelardi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: bo‘ron haqida: o‘ta kuchli, shiddatli va vayronkor
meanings.uzbekExample: Kuchli va shiddatli bo‘ron ko‘tarildi.

meanings.arabicGloss: عَنِيفُ اللَّهْجَةِ وَالْكَلاَمِ- يَلْقَانِي بِوَجْهٍ صَلْبٍ وَ لِسانٍ هَدَّارٍ. (التوحيدي).

meanings.uzbekExample: U meni sovuq chehra va keskin til bilan qarshi oldi.

issues: Beshinchi ma’no nutqning shunchaki ta’sirliligi emas, ohang va so‘zning keskin hamda qattiqligi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعَّال لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|1- عَالِمٌ عَبَّارٌ :مُفَسِّرُ الأَحْلاَمِ.|2- جَمَلٌ عَبَّارٌ : قَوِيٌّ عَلَى السَّيْرِ.
entries.uzbek: tush ta’birchisi; uzoq yurishga bardoshli tuya

meanings.uzbekExample: Olim tushlarni ta’bir qilish bilan shug‘ullandi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: tuya haqida: uzoq yo‘l yurishga kuchli va bardoshli
meanings.uzbekExample: Tuya uzoq yo‘l yurishga bardoshli edi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعَّال لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|1- غُرَابٌ نَعَّابٌ : كَثِيرُ الصِّيَاحِ.|2- نَعَّابُ الْغُرَابِ : فَرْخُهُ.|3- نَاقَةٌ نَعَّابَةٌ : سَرِيعَةٌ.
entries.uzbek: ko‘p qag‘illaydigan qarg‘a; qarg‘a jo‘jasi; tez tuya

meanings.uzbekMeaning: qarg‘a haqida: tez-tez va ko‘p qag‘illaydigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Qarg‘a ko‘p qag‘illardi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: qarg‘aning bolasi yoki jo‘jasi
meanings.uzbekExample: Qarg‘a jo‘jasi inida turardi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: urg‘ochi tuya haqida: tez yuradigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Urg‘ochi tuya tez yurardi.

issues: Qarg‘a tovushi tabiiy o‘zbekcha «qag‘illamoq» fe’li bilan berildi

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعَّال لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|1- كَانَ العَلَمُ خَفَّاقاً فِي العُلاَ : مُرَفْرِفاً فِي العُلاَ.|2- لَهُ قَلْبٌ خَفَّاقٌ :يَخْفِقُ كَثِيراً.
entries.uzbek: hilpirab turgan bayroq; tez-tez uradigan yurak

meanings.uzbekMeaning: bayroq haqida: balandda shamol bilan hilpirab turgan
meanings.uzbekExample: Bayroq balandda hilpirab turardi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: yurak haqida: tez-tez yoki qattiq uradigan, hayajon bilan dukillaydigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Uning yuragi tez urardi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعَّال لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|1- لَعَّابٌ مَاِهٌر : لاَعِبٌ جَيِّدٌ.|2- أَرَاهُ لَعَّاباً بَيْنَ أَصْحَابِهِ : كَثِيرُ الْمُزَاحِ وَالْمُدَاعَبَةِ.
entries.uzbek: mohir o‘yinchi; hazil-mutoyibani ko‘p qiluvchi

meanings.uzbekMeaning: o‘yin yoki sportda yaxshi o‘ynaydigan mohir o‘yinchi
meanings.uzbekExample: U mohir o‘yinchi edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: do‘stlari orasida hazil, ermak va mutoyibani ko‘p qiladigan kishi
meanings.uzbekExample: U do‘stlari orasida hazil-mutoyibani ko‘p qilardi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعَّال لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|1- لَوْنٌ أَبْيَضُ نَصَّاعٌ : خَالِصٌ.|2- حُمْرَةٌ نَصَّاعَةٌ : خَالِصَةٌ صَافِيَةٌ.
entries.uzbek: sof va yorqin oq; tiniq va yorqin qizil

meanings.uzbekMeaning: oq rang haqida: boshqa tus aralashmagan, sof va yorqin
meanings.uzbekExample: Mato sof va yorqin oq rangda edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: qizil rang haqida: sof, tiniq va yorqin
meanings.uzbekExample: Gulning qizil rangi sof va yorqin edi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعَّال لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|1- مَصَّاصُ اللَّيْلِ : هَامَةٌ، أَيْ جُثَّةٌ خُرَافِيَّةٌ يُقَالُ إِنَّهَا تُغَادِرُ قَبْرَهَا لَيْلاً لِتَمْتَصَّ دِمَاءَ النَّائِمِينَ.|2- مَصَّاصُ الدِّمَاءِ : القَاتِلُ الوَحْشِيُّ.|3- عُرِفَ فِي الأَسْوَاقِ بِأَنَّهُ مَصَّاصٌ لِلدِّمَاءِ : الْمُبْتَزُّ لِأَمْوَالِ النَّاسِ.
entries.uzbek: afsonaviy qonxo‘r; vahshiy qotil; odamlar molini tovlamachilik bilan oluvchi

meanings.arabicGloss: هَامَةٌ، أَيْ جُثَّةٌ خُرَافِيَّةٌ يُقَالُ إِنَّهَا تُغَادِرُ قَبْرَهَا لَيْلاً لِتَمْتَصَّ دِمَاءَ النَّائِمِينَ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: tunda qabridan chiqib, uxlayotgan odamlarning qonini so‘radi deb tasavvur qilinadigan afsonaviy maxluq — vampir
meanings.uzbekExample: Afsonalarda vampir tunda qabridan chiqadigan maxluq sifatida tasvirlanadi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: «qonxo‘r» iborasida: o‘ta shafqatsiz va vahshiy qotil
meanings.uzbekExample: U shafqatsiz qotil sifatida qoralandi.

meanings.arabicExample: عُرِفَ فِي الأَسْوَاقِ بِأَنَّهُ مَصَّاصٌ لِلدِّمَاءِ
meanings.uzbekMeaning: odamlarning pul va molini tazyiq, tovlamachilik yoki nohaq yo‘l bilan tortib oladigan kishi
meanings.uzbekExample: Bozorda u odamlarning molini tovlamachilik bilan oluvchi sifatida tanilgan edi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعَّال لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|1- نَسِيجٌ شَفَّافٌ : رَقِيقٌ، أَيْ كُلُّ مَا رَقَّ فَظَهَرَ مَا وَرَاءهُ.|2- مَاءٌ شَفَّافٌ : صَافٍ.
entries.uzbek: orqasi ko‘rinadigan shaffof mato; tiniq suv

meanings.arabicGloss: رَقِيقٌ، أَيْ كُلُّ مَا رَقَّ فَظَهَرَ مَا وَرَاءهُ.
meanings.uzbekMeaning: mato yoki yupqa narsa haqida: orqasidagi narsa ko‘rinadigan darajada nozik va shaffof
meanings.uzbekExample: Mato yupqa va orqasi ko‘rinadigan darajada shaffof edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: suv haqida: loyqa va aralashmalarsiz, tiniq
meanings.uzbekExample: Suv musaffo va tiniq edi.

entries.arabicDefinition: (صِيغَةُ فَعَّال لِلْمُبَالَغَةِ).|1- نُورٌ وَهَّاجٌ : شَدِيدُ الوَهَجِ.|2- نَجْمٌ وَهَّاجٌ : وَقَّادٌ، سَاطِعٌ- الشَّمْسُ مُشْرِقَةٌ فِي كَبِدِ السَّمَاءِ وَهَّاجَةٌ كَعَادَتِهَا فِي مُدُنِ السَّاحِلِ. (حنا مينه).|3- نَظَرٌ وَهَّاجٌ : مُشِعٌّ- يَبْدُو وَهَّاجَ النَّظَرَاتِ، مَشْبُوبَ الشَّغَفِ فِي الْحِسِّ. (محمود تيمور) النبأ آية 13وَجَعَلْنَا سِرَاجاً وَهَّاجاً ( قرآن).|4- ذَهَبٌ وَهَّاجٌ : لَمَّاعٌ.
entries.uzbek: kuchli shu’la sochuvchi; porloq yulduz; ehtirosli nigoh; yaltiroq oltin

meanings.uzbekMeaning: nur yoki chiroq haqida: kuchli harorat va shu’la taratadigan, lovullab yorishadigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Biz o‘ta yorqin va issiqlik sochuvchi chiroqni yaratdik. (Qur’on, Naba surasi, 78:13)

meanings.arabicGloss: وَقَّادٌ، سَاطِعٌ- الشَّمْسُ مُشْرِقَةٌ فِي كَبِدِ السَّمَاءِ وَهَّاجَةٌ كَعَادَتِهَا فِي مُدُنِ السَّاحِلِ. (حنا مينه).
meanings.uzbekMeaning: yulduz yoki quyosh haqida: juda porloq, lovullab nur sochadigan
meanings.uzbekExample: Quyosh osmon o‘rtasida lovullab nur sochardi.

meanings.arabicGloss: مُشِعٌّ- يَبْدُو وَهَّاجَ النَّظَرَاتِ، مَشْبُوبَ الشَّغَفِ فِي الْحِسِّ. (محمود تيمور) النبأ آية 13وَجَعَلْنَا سِرَاجاً وَهَّاجاً ( قرآن).
meanings.uzbekMeaning: nigoh haqida: nur sochib turgandek yorqin, kuchli ehtiros va hayajon ifodalovchi
meanings.uzbekExample: Uning nigohlari yorqin va ehtirosga to‘la edi.

meanings.uzbekMeaning: oltin haqida: yorug‘likni qaytarib, kuchli yaltirab turgan
meanings.uzbekExample: Oltin kuchli yaltirab turardi.

issues: Naba surasi 78:13 dagi «سِرَاجاً وَهَّاجاً» nigohga tegishli emas; manba joylashuvidagi xato tuzatilib, kuchli shu’la va issiqlik sochuvchi chiroq ma’nosiga ko‘chirildi
